objects.prompt:
General Description:
Generate a comprehensive collection of icons and modular graphic elements for a game Heads-Up Display (HUD) featuring a distinct Urban Cyberpunk Neon aesthetic. The visual style must synthesize the dense, high-energy atmosphere of Tokyo (characterized by neon signage and digital displays) with the cosmopolitan, modern architecture of New York.

Technical Guidelines:

Resolution: Strictly 32x32 pixels per individual asset (or modular equivalents for composite elements like bars).

Style: High-definition Pixel Art with crisp, clean anti-aliased outlines (modern 8-bit/16-bit interpretation).

Color Palette: High contrast is mandatory. All elements must be set against a solid dark or black background (which will be made transparent) using intensely saturated, vibrant neon colors: Electric Cyan, Magenta, Lime Green, Bright Yellow, and Cobalt Blue.

Format: Final assets must have transparent backgrounds (PNG format), organized logically within a spritesheet or as individual files.

Specific Asset List:

1. Status and Attribute Icons (32x32 px)

Health/HP: A stylized pixelated heart or a futuristic medical cross, glowing in neon red or pink.

Energy/Stamina: A lightning bolt, a battery cell, or a running icon, glowing in neon cyan or yellow.

Hunger/Thirst: Stylized icons of a hamburger or a water glass, outlined in neon orange or green.

Defense/Shield: A hexagonal shield icon or a forcefield barrier outline, in neon blue.

2. Modular Bar Elements (Variable Width, Height 32px)

Empty Bar Container: A dark, metallic frame or a frosted glass tube designed to serve as the base structure for HP/Energy bars.

Bar Fill (HP): A solid texture or gradient designed to fill the health bar, using glowing neon red.

Bar Fill (Energy): A texture for filling the energy bar, using glowing neon cyan.

Window Corner Pieces: Modular corner elements (top-left, top-right, etc.) featuring an industrial/cyberpunk design language for constructing text boxes, inventory windows, or menus.

3. System and Menu Icons (32x32 px)

Inventory: An icon of a tactical backpack, a travel suitcase, or a toolbox, glowing in neon yellow.

Map: An icon of a folded paper map, a stylized GPS pin, or a holographic globe, in neon green.

Quests/Journal: An icon of a holographic scroll, a tablet device, or a notebook featuring an exclamation mark, in neon magenta.

Settings/Options: A classic gear icon or a linear control panel slider, in neon white or gray.

4. Cursor and Reticle Elements (32x32 px)

Standard Cursor: A stylized mouse pointer arrow with a glowing outline (e.g., white fill with a cyan border).

Interaction Cursor: A pixelated hand or a rotating loading circle, in neon green.

Targeting Reticle: A simple central point, an "X," or a small open circle for use in combat areas, in neon red or pink.

Visual Style Reference (Mental Mood Board):
Visualize a nocturnal scene in Shinjuku, Tokyo, reflected sharply in the rain puddles of a Manhattan street, with dense electronic signs and LED lights glowing intensely against the dark concrete. The icons should appear as small digital terminals or floating holograms within this environment.
